description: This file defines data classes and functions related to index version 2 (IndexV2) for the FDroid project, including classes for entries, files, repositories, and related entities used in the indexing system.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents an index entry with timestamp, version, optional maxAge, an index file, and diffs.

classes.name: EntryFileV2
classes.description: Represents a version 2 index file with serialization/deserialization methods.

classes.name: FileV2
classes.description: Represents a file in the index with serialization/deserialization methods.

classes.name: IndexV2
classes.description: Represents the overall index containing a repository and packages.

classes.name: RepoV2
classes.description: Represents a repository with metadata, icons, mirrors, categories, and release channels.

classes.name: MirrorV2
classes.description: Represents a mirror with URL and optional country code.

classes.name: AntiFeatureV2
classes.description: Represents an anti-feature with icon, name, and description.

classes.name: CategoryV2
classes.description: Represents a category with icon, name, and description.

classes.name: ReleaseChannelV2
classes.description: Represents a release channel with name and description.

methods.name: getDiff
methods.description: Returns the diff EntryFileV2 for a given timestamp, or null if none exists.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a string into an EntryFileV2 object.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object into a JSON string.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a string into a FileV2 object, handling null or empty input.

methods.name: fromPath
methods.description: Creates a FileV2 object from a file path string.

methods.name: walkFiles
methods.description: Traverses files in the repo or packages, applying a consumer function.
